name: USB Hub Support
author: NachoCasta
summary: USB hubs with offline source recovery and reliable touch eject.
description: Connect up to eight USB sticks through a hub, including HFS+ exports. Hub sources work without Ethernet and recover after power-on. USB numbers follow hub ports, with native sources first. Shows rekordbox names/colors and waveforms. Press USB STOP to select a stick or hold to eject the hub; wait for confirmation. Touch controls remain available if knob input stops. Experimental Ethernet sharing; actual CDJs and Wi-Fi sharing remain unvalidated. Large libraries may exceed sharing limits. Exact firmware ep147-9e9454e357389ece, kernel4.4.194; core>=1.2.3.
